payload.description:
As a platform operator, I want the scoring-only container to contain only required runtime packages and pass image vulnerability gates, so that promoted artifacts do not expose avoidable operating-system attack surface.

Feature: Minimal secure scoring runtime image

Scenario: Build the scoring-only runtime
Given scoring dependencies are available as Python wheels or copied source
When the scoring runtime container is built
Then it does not install source-control, visualization, or native client packages that scoring does not execute
And the published image contains no critical or high scan findings before promotion
payload.title: Published scoring runtime excludes unnecessary vulnerable system packages
